intent: One focused feature grid for an analytics product: a hairline bento of six live tiles drawn in markup, monochrome with one signal accent, dark first, every tile choreographed on entrance.

layout.root: section with @container and theme tokens as CSS variables; max-w-7xl inner, px 16/32/48, py 40/64/80. No marketing header by default: an optional header (eyebrow, heading + muted clause, intro, link) renders only when `heading` is passed.
layout.grid: gap-px, no backing colour; each tile carries a 1px ring in a solid rule colour that fills the gap, so rules arrive with their tiles; 1px outer border, radius 22px, overflow hidden
layout.tile: padding 24/32px; mono label, 22-24px display title, 15px body; illustration pushed down with mt-auto
layout.composition: tiles are exported; <BentoGrid> with children renders them inside the themed hairline sheet

stat.unit: about a third of the number's size

color.approach: monochrome first: black, white and greys; one accent prop for live/peak signals only
color.accent: #d5f56a by default (prop): trend end dot, heatmap peak cell, live dot, city dots and rings, the answer's last mini-bar. Nothing else.
color.inkScale: text 50-85% ink; heat levels 6/16/34/60/100% ink; switches ink track with surface-coloured knob
color.tokens: one PALETTE object per theme, written to --bn-* variables; tiles re-point --bn-ink locally to invert or deepen

motion.timeline: per tile, seconds after the tile starts: tile lands 0 (opacity + 16px rise, no blur, 0.6s) → label/title/body 0.08/0.13/0.18 (12px rise out of 8px blur) → figures 0.24 (count up from 0 over 0.9s with an 8px blur that clears) → data 0.30 (chart/map draw 0.7s, cells wave in, bars grow) → progress 0.62 (meters fill, top-city list). Tiles in a row start 70ms apart; rows lower in the viewport start up to 220ms later.
motion.trend: line revealed by widening a clipPath rect (non-scaling stroke, not pathLength); end dot springs in as the line arrives; d morphs over 0.9s; metrics cycle every 4.2s while on screen until clicked; each new total re-counts from zero
motion.stat: 184 counts up out of a blur; Northstar meter fills in 0.35s, the warehouse meter crawls 1.4s linear (the joke)
motion.heatmap: 168 plain spans with CSS opacity/scale transitions delayed in a diagonal wave (12ms per step); then a random cell pops every 650ms
motion.search: types 38-88ms per char, holds the answer 2.6s, erases 3 chars per 18ms; answer card cross-fades with a 4px blur; mini-bars grow from the baseline
motion.alerts: preview, then switch rows stagger 50ms; a switch flips every 1.7s until touched; knob on spring 500/40
motion.map: total counts up; dot world sweeps in west to east via a clipPath; each city springs in as the sweep passes; rings expand r 1.6→7 over 2.4s only after the sweep; counts tick every 1.1s; top-4 list re-sorts with layout
motion.implementation: figures are motion values rendered as children (no per-frame setState); loops run only while the tile is on screen
motion.staging: everything starts hidden in server HTML; tiles at least 25% on screen at mount play; tiles 320px below the fold at mount render finished and replay when they approach; anything else (deep links, full-page screenshots) renders finished
motion.reducedMotion: final states immediately, no loops, no typing, no counting

responsive.base: single column; segmented control under the title; map total under the title; top cities in 2 columns
responsive.@3xl: 2 columns; trend and map full width

accessibility: section aria-labelledby the h2; tiles are articles with h3s
metric buttons use aria-pressed; settings rows are role=switch buttons with aria-checked, 60px tall
typing animation aria-hidden, with an sr-only list of queries and answers
heatmap and map are role=img with descriptive labels

content.heading: Analytics that / answer back.
tiles: Rhythm: Know when they show up
Ask: Ask it like you'd ask a person
queries: why did churn spike on tuesday?

avoid: a marketing headline baked into the component
tinted tiles or a coloured stat tile
a grey backing slab that shows while tiles fade in
loops running off screen or under reduced motion
